description: Source file implementing functions and classes for managing oblivious HTTP header key configurations, including serialization, parsing, validation, and support for cryptographic identifiers.

classes.name: ObliviousHttpHeaderKeyConfig
classes.description: Class representing configuration for oblivious HTTP header keys, including cryptographic identifiers and serialization/parsing methods.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Factory method to create and validate an ObliviousHttpHeaderKeyConfig instance.

methods.name: ValidateKeyConfig
methods.description: Validates the cryptographic identifiers in the configuration.

methods.name: GetHpkeKem
methods.description: Returns the HPKE KEM object based on the configuration.

methods.name: GetHpkeKdf
methods.description: Returns the HPKE KDF object based on the configuration.

methods.name: GetHpkeAead
methods.description: Returns the HPKE AEAD object based on the configuration.

methods.name: SerializeRecipientContextInfo
methods.description: Serializes the context info for recipient.

methods.name: ParseOhttpPayloadHeader
methods.description: Parses the OHTTP payload header from bytes or reader.

methods.name: ParseKeyIdFromObliviousHttpRequestPayload
methods.description: Extracts key ID from request payload bytes.
